run.title: Adventure run: {{world}}
run.intro: Grab coins, bop monsters by landing on them (not the spiky ones!), bounce on springs. At the end, jump up into the block with the right answer.
run.introNoSpiky: Grab coins, bop monsters by landing on them and bounce on springs. At the end, jump up into the block with the right answer.
run.controlsKeys: Arrow keys or A / D to move · Space or ↑ to jump
run.controlsTouch: Hold ◀ ▶ to move · tap ⤒ to jump
run.quizCard: Answer with a quiz card instead

toast.spiky: Ouch! Spiky ones can't be bopped. Jump over them!
toast.side: Oops! Land on top to bop it.
toast.tried: You already tried that one. Pick another block!
toast.finish: Jump up into the right answer!
